summary: Add closed read-only service admission for claims, exact work items and documents while keeping production service issuance disabled

replay.detail: No migration; grant storage and digest authentication retain their existing meanings.

schema.detail: No fractal-schema or device pairing changes.

rules.detail: Service bearers on both routers require an exact registered GET/read-scope pair. Unknown routes, upgrades and every mutation are refused before dispatch. Work reads do not acknowledge wakes; daemon-owned read-window audits are bounded per grant.

compatibility.detail: Assistant scopes, disclosure consent and tests are unchanged. Service issuance remains disabled; owner lifecycle and rollout safety remain prerequisites.
